items.title: Every 3D artist should have an AI assistant, Maxon says as it launches new tools and agentic licences
items.excerpt: Maxon Plus brings AI 3D model generation into Cinema 4D and ZBrush, browser-based 3D review, and new 'agentic licences' for Cinema 4D and Autograph, with an off switch for artists who don't want generation.
items.rationale: New release from a core 3D vendor: AI model generation inside Cinema 4D/ZBrush, browser review and agentic licences (with an opt-out) change how 3D/motion designers license and use their tools.

items.title: Buro Happold and Motif bridge the BIM collaboration divide
items.excerpt: Buro Happold's open-source BHoM engineering framework is being integrated into Motif's BIM 2.0 platform so Motif's agents, which turn sketches and prompts into geometry, can call deterministic engineering methods for sizing and calcs. Early demo.
items.rationale: New integration pairing prompt/sketch-to-geometry agents with deterministic open-source engineering calcs — a concrete answer to 'can AI-generated building geometry be trusted'.

items.title: Design for the Verify: 5 UX patterns for trustworthy AI
items.excerpt: LexisNexis's design team lays out five UX patterns that let users verify AI output in a professional legal-research product.
items.rationale: First-party design team sharing five reusable verification patterns from a shipped high-stakes AI product — directly applicable to anyone designing AI features.

items.title: Pin agent spacing to the existing spacing scale — no magic margin or padding values
items.excerpt: Coding agents sprinkle one-off values like mt-[13px] into layouts; the fix is to hand them the design system's spacing scale and reject off-scale values.
items.rationale: Actionable tokens guardrail: feed coding agents the spacing scale and reject off-scale values — a fix design-system owners can apply tomorrow.

items.title: SK에코플랜트, 설계에도 AI 적용…도면 검토·장비 배치 업무 줄인다 (AXen)
items.excerpt: SK Ecoplant put its design-specialised AI platform AXen into operation: it proposes space/equipment layouts from accumulated design data, compares alternatives, detects clashes and suggests fixes, and searches codes and standards; designer-approved results feed back into the model. Part of a '1 person 1 agent' push.
items.rationale: Concrete Korean design-AX deployment: AXen in production for layout proposals, clash detection and code search, with designer approval feeding back into the model.
